welcome.welcome.title: Welcome to POKIT
welcome.welcome.body: A lightweight app to collect daily routines and stay focused at your own pace.
welcome.today.title: Collect and continue today
welcome.today.body: Gather today’s routines and organize your day with importance underlines and completion marks.
welcome.routines.title: Create and group routines
welcome.routines.body: In the Routines tab, switch between list, templates, and My routines to organize sets and Apply them into Today.
welcome.modes.title: Notes, todos, and reading in one place
welcome.modes.body: Take quick notes, organize todos, and manage reading goals in one app.
welcome.next.title: Track progress and dive deeper anytime
welcome.next.body: Completed routines are saved in History.
welcome.next.note: You can explore with “Try POKIT quickly” on Today, or open Settings → User guide anytime.
tour.pokitWeek.listHint: Tap an item for a tip. “Got it” checks it off. You can finish them all in one go.

tour.pokitWeek.step1.title: Browse the Routines tab
tour.pokitWeek.step1.body: Use the Routines icon above to browse every routine in one list.
tour.pokitWeek.step2.title: Create your own routine
tour.pokitWeek.step2.body: In the Routines tab, open My routines, then tap “+” for a group or expand Daily / Weekend fixed sets.
tour.pokitWeek.step3.title: Open Puzzle
tour.pokitWeek.step3.body: Tap the Puzzle icon above to see how your records become a photo.
tour.pokitWeek.step4.title: Try the todo list
tour.pokitWeek.step4.body: Open todos with the checklist icon above.
tour.pokitWeek.step5.title: Open the bookstore
tour.pokitWeek.step5.body: Open Reading with the book icon above.
tour.pokitWeek.step6.title: Write a lock-screen memo
tour.pokitWeek.step6.body: Open Lock-screen memo with the note icon above.
tour.pokitWeek.step7.title: Write a note
tour.pokitWeek.step7.body: Open Note mode with the pencil icon above.
tour.pokitWeek.step8.title: Change layout in Settings
tour.pokitWeek.step8.body: Open Settings with the gear icon above, then Layout.
tour.pokitWeek.layoutNudge.title: Want to tweak the Today layout?
tour.pokitWeek.layoutNudge.body: You can change the Today tab layout. Check it out in Settings.
tour.pokitWeek.widgetNudge.title: Want to add Home Screen widgets too?
tour.pokitWeek.widgetNudge.body: POKIT widgets live on your iPhone Home Screen, not inside the app. Pin routines, bookstore, or notes for a quick glance.
tour.pokitWeek.puzzleNudge.title: Complete routines to finish your photo with sticky notes
tour.pokitWeek.puzzleNudge.body: Pick a favorite photo—each linked-routine completion adds a sticky note until the picture is revealed.

appUpdate.nudgeMessage: A new update is available. Get the latest version from the store.
appUpdate.release.default: We improved app stability and everyday usability.
appUpdate.release.1_9_5.h1: Complete routines and sticky-note puzzle pieces stick on until your photo is done.
appUpdate.release.1_9_5.h2: After the widget tip, the puzzle guide follows next.
appUpdate.release.1_9_5.h3: When starting a photo, you can only pick in-progress routines on Today.
appUpdate.release.1_9_4.h1: When a new version is out, an update tip appears in the daily quote spot.
appUpdate.release.1_9_4.h2: You can hide the update tip in Layout settings.
appUpdate.release.1_9_4.h3: Smoother routine/sticky colors and more reliable pinned Home widget routines.
appUpdate.release.1_9_0.h1: After Trying POKIT, a Home widget tip follows next.
appUpdate.release.1_9_0.h2: Widget guide images show a skeleton while loading.
appUpdate.release.1_9_0.h3: Tutorial screens use soft shadows instead of heavy borders.
appUpdate.release.1_8_20.h1: Many more colors for routine memo faces and importance marks.
appUpdate.release.1_8_20.h2: Mark all announcements as read in one tap.
appUpdate.release.1_8_20.h3: Lock-screen memo cards are now titled Post-it.
appUpdate.release.1_8_15.h1: Pick a routine memo color for Today-tab routine cards.
appUpdate.release.1_8_15.h2: Dark green and navy memo colors use white text for readability.
appUpdate.release.1_8_15.h3: Check recent update notes in Settings.
appUpdate.release.1_8_14.h1: Routine start times now stay saved after you reopen the app.
appUpdate.release.1_8_14.h2: Start times from My Routines stay in sync with Start Notifications.
appUpdate.release.1_8_14.h3: Fixed start notifications that could duplicate or fail to schedule.
appUpdate.release.1_8_10.h1: Book list now shows current/total pages and last read date.
appUpdate.release.1_8_10.h2: Today’s pages default to 0; polished completion and memo copy.
appUpdate.release.1_8_10.h3: Cleaner bookstore input underlines and guide UI.
appUpdate.release.1_8_9.h1: Bookstore add, search, and guides polished with angular layout and burgundy accents.
appUpdate.release.1_8_9.h2: Lighter add/search buttons and clearer guide copy.
appUpdate.release.1_8_9.h3: Clearer nudge to tap a book in the list for details.
appUpdate.release.1_8_8.h1: Polished reading: pages logged, progress, and completion share.
appUpdate.release.1_8_8.h2: Count routines now set name and goal first, then fill with −1/+1.
appUpdate.release.1_8_8.h3: Softer shadows on the to-do list.
appUpdate.release.1_8_7.h1: Routine icon, color, and name now stay in sync across detail settings, the list, and Today.
appUpdate.release.1_8_7.h2: Routines imported from the web keep their name when you only change the icon.
appUpdate.release.1_8_7.h3: Smoother color picking and delete support for built-in routines.
appUpdate.release.1_8_6.h1: The light-mode Day Balance dial now uses a purple base so activity and sleep stand out more.
appUpdate.release.1_8_6.h2: Polished how the day start and end settings screen is shown.
appUpdate.release.1_8_6.h3: Small stability and display tweaks for a smoother feel.
appUpdate.release.1_8_5.h2: Unread notices show a soft badge on Settings.
appUpdate.release.1_8_5.h3: Softened History card shadows for a lighter look.
appUpdate.release.1_8_4.h2: Unread notices show a soft badge on Settings.
appUpdate.release.1_8_4.h3: Softened History card shadows for a lighter look.
appUpdate.release.1_8_3.h1: Tightened spacing on the Today-tab mode icons.
appUpdate.release.1_8_3.h2: Day-start alerts now fire at the time you set—without duplicates.
appUpdate.release.1_8_3.h3: You can hide Today-tab routine icons in Layout settings.
appUpdate.release.1_8_2.h1: You can hide Today-tab routine icons in Layout settings.
appUpdate.release.1_8_2.h2: Day-start alerts now fire at the time you set—without duplicates.
appUpdate.release.1_8_2.h3: Polished Today-tab icons and Settings / Notifications UI.
appUpdate.release.1_8_0.h1: Bag routines now only need a start time.
appUpdate.release.1_8_0.h2: In overnight day windows, same-day starts sort above next-day dawn times.
appUpdate.release.1_8_0.h3: Fixed the first-time setup screen reappearing or blocking taps after switching tabs.
appUpdate.release.1_7_11.h1: When the day rolls over, the date advances and only weekday-matched fixed routines return.
appUpdate.release.1_7_11.h2: Yesterday’s bag, sections, and quick memos clear so today starts fresh.
appUpdate.release.1_7_11.h3: Adding a routine no longer fills in a time—only times you set yourself appear.
appUpdate.release.1_7_10.h1: Daily focus time and same-day / next-day settings apply more reliably.
appUpdate.release.1_7_10.h2: Routines clear from Today after focus ends or when a weekday is turned off.
appUpdate.release.1_7_10.h3: When focus ends, the time button is highlighted to guide a change.
appUpdate.release.1_7_8.h1: Reminder times for intake and medicine stay inside today’s routine.
appUpdate.release.1_7_8.h2: Icon colors from routine settings now match the Today list.
appUpdate.release.1_7_8.h3: You can rename a routine even from today’s plan.
appUpdate.release.1_7_7.h1: The today-tab note now has a toolbar for bullets, numbered lists, and undo.
appUpdate.release.1_7_7.h2: Fixed the note so the keyboard no longer covers what you’re writing.
appUpdate.release.1_7_7.h3: The memo list now opens and closes more smoothly.
appUpdate.release.1_7_6.h1: Set day start and wrap-up on a 48-hour dial that shows active and sleep time.
appUpdate.release.1_7_6.h2: Turn day-start and daily-review alerts on or off in Settings > Notifications.
appUpdate.release.1_7_6.h3: Fixed the today-tab todo list so the keyboard no longer covers what you’re typing.
appUpdate.release.1_7_5.h1: Polished today’s todo list with sub-tasks, highlighter marks, and per-item copy/share.
appUpdate.release.1_7_5.h2: Retouched the todo time sheet with snapped pickers and a mint save button.
appUpdate.release.1_7_5.h3: Kept check and trash boxes consistent on green and navy post-it faces.
appUpdate.release.1_7_4.h1: Creating a routine no longer asks you to pick a bundle.
appUpdate.release.1_7_4.h2: You can delete built-in default routines from the list.
appUpdate.release.1_7_4.h3: Polished create-routine and routine list guidance and UI.
appUpdate.release.1_7_3.h1: Added highlighter-style importance marks for routines in your bag.
appUpdate.release.1_7_3.h2: Aligned start/end and routine time settings with the Settings tab style.
appUpdate.release.1_7_3.h3: Balanced font sizes across typefaces and polished the City Pop UI.

widgetGuide.title: Widget guide
widgetGuide.lead: POKIT widgets are added from the iPhone Home Screen (or Lock Screen), not from inside the app. There is no add button in Settings. Follow the steps below.
widgetGuide.photoLead: Add POKIT from the Home Screen. There is no add button in Settings.
puzzleGuide.slide.wall.body: The more routines you complete, the more sticky notes stick on—and your photo comes together.
puzzleGuide.slide.target.body: Choose how many completions finish the photo. You can’t change this after you start.
puzzleGuide.slide.photo.body: Crop a favorite photo to a square. You can also set the puzzle name here.
puzzleGuide.slide.tip.body: Finished photos collect in the album. Rename with the pencil, or delete with trash.
widgetGuide.slide.intro.body: POKIT widgets you pin to the Home Screen.
widgetGuide.slide.edit.body: Long-press to edit, then tap the blue “Expand routine” value again and pick from the list.
widgetGuide.slide.bookstore.body: Tap blue “Tap to pick a book” to pin a title.
widgetGuide.slide.note.body: Tap the blue “Open note” value to pick which note to pin.
widgetGuide.slide.tip.body: Text color, highlighter, and underline from each routine show on its widget too. You can also add several widgets and pick differently for each.
widgetGuide.section.add.title: Add to the Home Screen
widgetGuide.section.add.lead: Find POKIT in the iOS widget gallery and add a widget.
widgetGuide.section.add.s1.label: Touch and hold an empty area
widgetGuide.section.add.s1.detail: Touch and hold an empty area on the Home Screen until the apps jiggle.
widgetGuide.section.add.s2.label: Tap + in the top left
widgetGuide.section.add.s2.detail: Tap the + button at the top left to open the widget gallery.
widgetGuide.section.add.s3.label: Find POKIT
widgetGuide.section.add.s3.detail: Type POKIT in search or scroll the list and choose POKIT.
widgetGuide.section.add.s4.label: Choose a widget
widgetGuide.section.add.s4.detail: Pick Today routines, Routine, Bookstore, or Note.
widgetGuide.section.add.s5.label: Choose a size
widgetGuide.section.add.s5.detail: Only small and medium sizes are available. Large is not supported.
widgetGuide.section.add.s6.label: Add Widget
widgetGuide.section.add.s6.detail: Tap Add Widget to place it. You can move it later.
widgetGuide.section.add.note1: If a large widget is already on the Home Screen, remove it there. Large no longer appears in the gallery.
widgetGuide.section.kinds.title: Widget types
widgetGuide.section.kinds.lead: POKIT has four Home widgets, plus Today routines on the Lock Screen.
widgetGuide.section.kinds.s1.label: Today routines
widgetGuide.section.kinds.s1.detail: Shows today’s routines, completion, and quick memo. Nothing to pick in Edit Widget.
widgetGuide.section.kinds.s2.label: Routine
widgetGuide.section.kinds.s2.detail: Shows one routine — checklist, weight, intake, and so on. Each widget can show a different routine.
widgetGuide.section.kinds.s3.label: Bookstore
widgetGuide.section.kinds.s3.detail: Shows the title, pages, and progress of a book from the bookstore. Each widget can show a different book.
widgetGuide.section.kinds.s4.label: Note
widgetGuide.section.kinds.s4.detail: Pins one Today-tab note. The picker uses date titles, and same-day pages continue as · 2.
widgetGuide.section.kinds.s5.label: Lock Screen · Today routines
widgetGuide.section.kinds.s5.detail: Touch and hold the Lock Screen, then add widgets and choose POKIT Today routines.
widgetGuide.section.edit.title: Choose what to show
widgetGuide.section.edit.lead: For Routine, Bookstore, and Note, touch and hold the widget on the Home Screen. This is not in the app Settings tab.
widgetGuide.section.edit.s1.label: Touch and hold the widget
widgetGuide.section.edit.s1.detail: Touch and hold the widget on the Home Screen.
widgetGuide.section.edit.s2.label: Edit Widget
widgetGuide.section.edit.s2.detail: Choose Edit Widget from the menu.
widgetGuide.section.edit.s3.label: Routine widget
widgetGuide.section.edit.s3.detail: In Edit Widget, tap the blue “Expand routine” value again to open the list. Candidates are routines on Today.
widgetGuide.section.edit.s4.label: Bookstore widget
widgetGuide.section.edit.s4.detail: Long-press, choose Edit Widget, then tap the blue “Tap to pick a book” row. Each widget shows one book.
widgetGuide.section.edit.s5.label: Note widget
widgetGuide.section.edit.s5.detail: Edit Widget shows notes as a list, newest date first. Same-day pages continue as “date · 2”.
widgetGuide.section.edit.s6.label: Today routines widget
widgetGuide.section.edit.s6.detail: Today’s list updates automatically. You don’t pick a routine in Edit Widget.
widgetGuide.section.edit.note1: If there is nothing to pick, the widget shows a short empty message. Prepare a routine, book, or note in the app first.
widgetGuide.section.notes.title: Picking a note
widgetGuide.section.notes.lead: Edit Widget shows every note you can pin as a list.
widgetGuide.section.notes.s1.label: Pick from the list
widgetGuide.section.notes.s1.detail: The date titles appear on the Edit Widget sheet. Tap a page to pin it to that widget.
widgetGuide.section.notes.s2.label: Sorted by date
widgetGuide.section.notes.s2.detail: Titles follow the created date, same as in the app. Newer dates are at the top.
widgetGuide.section.notes.s3.label: Several notes on the same day
widgetGuide.section.notes.s3.detail: Pages from the same day appear as “October 4, 2026”, “October 4, 2026 · 2”, “· 3”. They are not merged into one date.
widgetGuide.section.notes.s4.label: Tell them apart with the preview
widgetGuide.section.notes.s4.detail: Even on the same date, a body preview is shown so you can pick the right page.
widgetGuide.section.notes.s5.label: One widget = one page
widgetGuide.section.notes.s5.detail: Each widget pins one page. Add more Note widgets if you want several pages on the Home Screen.
widgetGuide.section.notes.note1: After you add or delete a page in Today notes, open Edit Widget again so the list matches.
widgetGuide.section.notes.note2: A custom title is used when you set one. Otherwise the date title is used.
widgetGuide.section.books.title: Picking a book
widgetGuide.section.books.lead: Long-press the bookstore widget and choose Edit Widget. Tap the book row to see every book in the bookstore.
widgetGuide.section.books.s1.label: Pick a book in Edit Widget
widgetGuide.section.books.s1.detail: Long-press the widget, open Edit Widget, then tap the blue “Tap to pick a book”. Harry Potter, Little Prince, and the rest of the bookstore appear in the list.
widgetGuide.section.books.s2.label: Every book in the bookstore
widgetGuide.section.books.s2.detail: Reading, want-to-read, and finished books are all in the list. Tabs do not hide them.
widgetGuide.section.books.s3.label: Same title
widgetGuide.section.books.s3.detail: Duplicate titles continue as “title · 2”, with author and status to tell them apart.
widgetGuide.section.books.s4.label: One widget = one book
widgetGuide.section.books.s4.detail: Each widget pins one book. Add more Bookstore widgets if you want several books on the Home Screen.
widgetGuide.section.books.note1: If an old bookstore widget has no Edit Widget, delete it and add it again.
widgetGuide.section.look.title: Color and size
widgetGuide.section.look.lead: Post-it colors are set on the routine in the Today tab, not in Settings.
widgetGuide.section.look.s1.label: Routine widget color
widgetGuide.section.look.s1.detail: Change the face and ink on a Today routine row to update widgets that show that routine.
widgetGuide.section.look.s2.label: Bookstore and Note color
widgetGuide.section.look.s2.detail: They use the default yellow post-it. Ink follows the Today tab.
widgetGuide.section.look.s3.label: Supported sizes
widgetGuide.section.look.s3.detail: Small and medium only. Large does not appear in the gallery.
widgetGuide.section.look.s4.label: When it updates
widgetGuide.section.look.s4.detail: Changes in the app show on the widget immediately or after a short delay.
widgetGuide.section.look.note2: You can add several widgets and pick a different routine, book, or note on each.

guideBook.page.cover.title: Bottom tabs
guideBook.page.cover.lead: POKIT splits your day across four bottom tabs.
guideBook.page.cover.c1.detail: See today’s bag, focus window, and the daily line next to the date.
guideBook.page.cover.c2.detail: Browse every routine in one list, search, and create new ones with icon and color. Manage My routines bundles inside this tab too.
guideBook.page.cover.c3.detail: Pick a favorite photo—each linked routine completion adds a sticky note until the picture is revealed.
guideBook.page.cover.c4.detail: Read articles and save them as routines.
guideBook.page.cover.note1: Weekly/monthly History isn’t a bottom tab—open it from Puzzle via “View weekly & monthly records”.
guideBook.page.chrome.title: Top modes & shortcuts
guideBook.page.chrome.lead: Above Today you’ll find mode switches and, on the right, Notices, Contact, and Settings.
guideBook.page.chrome.c1.detail: The default mode with today’s bag and list.
guideBook.page.chrome.c2.detail: Write a short memo for the lock screen.
guideBook.page.chrome.c3.detail: Keep a longer day note. The keyboard won’t cover the body text.
guideBook.page.chrome.c5.detail: Megaphone opens notices, paper plane opens support mail, and the gear opens Settings. In Layout you can hide only the Notices and Contact buttons.
guideBook.page.chrome.note1: Modes only change the Today experience—they’re not the bottom tabs.
guideBook.page.chrome.note2: Hiding Notices or Contact only affects the Today top bar. Those actions stay available in Settings.
guideBook.page.today-overview.title: Today tab screen
guideBook.page.today-overview.lead: Stack routines for today and view them as a list in your focus window. A daily encouragement line also sits next to the date.
guideBook.page.today-overview.c1.label: Date · focus window
guideBook.page.today-overview.c1.detail: Shows today’s date and day start–end (focus window). Tap the times to open the 48-hour circular dial.
guideBook.page.today-overview.c2.label: Quote of the day
guideBook.page.today-overview.c2.detail: A different encouragement line each day appears beside the date. Use copy or share to send it elsewhere.
guideBook.page.today-overview.c3.label: List · todos
guideBook.page.today-overview.c3.detail: List and todo icons on the header right. Todo opens the task screen.
guideBook.page.today-overview.c4.label: Stack area
guideBook.page.today-overview.c4.detail: When empty, you see hints and Add routine. After stacking, use Add more routines to keep adding.
guideBook.page.today-overview.c5.label: Bottom Today tab
guideBook.page.today-overview.note1: On first launch, set start and end on the circular dial in onboarding, then tap Get started. Later, change them in Settings → Day start/end and tap Save.
guideBook.page.today-overview.note2: The daily line stays the same for that day and changes when the date changes. In Settings → Layout you can also hide the quote strip, routine icons, and the Notices or Contact buttons.
guideBook.page.today-window.title: Start & wind-down time
guideBook.page.today-window.lead: Tap the header times to open a 48-hour circular dial. Drag the sun and moon handles to set day start and end.
guideBook.page.today-window.c1.label: Circular dial
guideBook.page.today-window.c1.detail: One lap is a day, two laps are two days. Drag the sun (start) and moon (end) handles to set the times.
guideBook.page.today-window.c2.label: Activity · sleep
guideBook.page.today-window.c2.detail: The center and arc show activity (start–end) and sleep (end–next start) as lengths like 5h 30m.
guideBook.page.today-window.c3.label: Same day / next day
guideBook.page.today-window.c3.detail: If end is earlier than start, the day continues into the next calendar day. You can also choose same day or next day yourself.
guideBook.page.today-window.c4.label: Apply · type times
guideBook.page.today-window.c4.detail: On Today the button is Apply; in Settings it is Save. Tap start or end to type an exact time.
guideBook.page.today-window.note1: Tap the date to pick an effective range (start/end dates) with Today, Reset, and Apply.
guideBook.page.today-layouts.title: List view
guideBook.page.today-layouts.lead: View stacked routines as a one-line list. Each row shows the icon, title, summary, and time.
guideBook.page.today-layouts.c1.label: List
guideBook.page.today-layouts.c1.detail: Stacked routines appear as a list. Add more routines sits centered below without a border box.
guideBook.page.today-layouts.c2.label: Todo shortcut
guideBook.page.today-layouts.c2.detail: Todo icon next to the list icon opens the task screen.
guideBook.page.today-layouts.note1: Turn on Hide routine icons in Settings → Layout to hide only the left icons.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.title: Add routines and row actions
guideBook.page.today-add-row.lead: After adding with Add routine, expand a row or tap buttons to manage it right away.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c1.label: Add / link routines
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c1.detail: Pick multiple at once. When creating a new routine, you can set the name, icon, and color.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c2.label: Priority
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c2.detail: Pick a color to mark importance. It shows as a highlighter underline on the title.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c3.label: Mark complete
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c3.detail: By default, complete with the mint check on the right. In Settings → Layout, turn on Complete in expanded panel to hide the check and use a mint Complete button (left of End) inside the row.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c4.label: Expand row · icon & color
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c4.detail: The chevron opens summary, time, and templates—and you can pick icon and color. Search icons in Korean or English, or browse Suggested, All, Exercise, Study, and more.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c5.label: Long-press · End · Done tape
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c5.detail: With 2+ items, long-press to reorder. After focus starts, End removes the item from today’s stack. A Done! tape may appear on completed rows; turn it off in Layout settings.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.note1: The icon catalog is curated to about 1,000 everyday symbols. More load as you scroll, and search covers icons you haven’t scrolled to yet.
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.title: Auto focus \u00b7 window end
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.lead: Today has no separate Start button\u2014your stack and focus window are what matter.
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c1.label: Stacking starts focus
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c1.detail: Adding a routine to the stack auto-starts focus on Today.
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c2.label: When the window ends
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c2.detail: Stack and focus state reset; unfinished flows may close and appear in History.
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c3.label: Keep stack
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c3.detail: Settings \u2192 Day start/end \u2192 Keep stack after day ends keeps items longer.
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c4.label: Apply integration
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c4.detail: With Apply on in My routines, changes reflect in today\u2019s stack and window.
guideBook.page.routine-list.title: Routine list
guideBook.page.routine-list.lead: Browse and create every routine in one flat list. Manage bundles and groups in the My routines tab.
guideBook.page.routine-list.c1.label: List / templates
guideBook.page.routine-list.c1.detail: List is for create/manage; templates preview layout styles.
guideBook.page.routine-list.c2.label: + button
guideBook.page.routine-list.c2.detail: Create a new routine. After choosing a template, set the name, icon, and color. Search icons or filter by Suggested, All, Exercise, Study, Health, Daily, Rest, or Hobby.
guideBook.page.routine-list.c3.label: Search · flat list
guideBook.page.routine-list.c3.detail: Search titles and descriptions at the top, then scroll one routine per row. There are no category bundles on this tab.
guideBook.page.routine-list.c4.label: Items · importance · edit
guideBook.page.routine-list.c4.detail: Expand an item to set importance (highlighter underline) or open detail settings. “Last 30 days · N times” shows how often you added it to Today. Delete items here too.
guideBook.page.routine-list.note1: City-pop illustrations behind the screen are decorative only and don’t affect taps.
guideBook.page.routine-templates.title: Routine templates
guideBook.page.routine-templates.lead: Cards open a note-style preview. The same templates are used when creating routines and in Today’s expanded rows.
guideBook.page.routine-templates.c1.deta: Check off tasks one by one. You can also edit them from an expanded Today row.
guideBook.page.routine-templates.c3.deta: Pick a metric, then type a number or use ±—it saves right away. There is no separate Save record button.
guideBook.page.routine-templates.c4.deta: Fill a target count with −/+. Preset chips quickly set the name and goal.
guideBook.page.routine-templates.c5.deta: Check off each scheduled time. Previews are not saved.
guideBook.page.my-routine.title: My routines screen
guideBook.page.my-routine.lead: Daily, weekend, and your groups stack as post-its. Manage routine bundles only here; set apply weekdays and Apply for today’s stack.
guideBook.page.my-routine.c1.label: Post-it list
guideBook.page.my-routine.c1.detail: Groups stack like post-its. Only the top group starts expanded; tap a header to open or close.
guideBook.page.my-routine.c2.label: Daily · weekend fixed
guideBook.page.my-routine.c2.detail: Daily fixed and Weekend fixed are built in. You can rename, delete, and set a title highlighter.
guideBook.page.my-routine.c3.label: Your groups
guideBook.page.my-routine.c3.detail: Custom groups you create. Add with + or Add group; rename or delete from the header.
guideBook.page.my-routine.c4.label: Apply · weekdays
guideBook.page.my-routine.c4.detail: Pick Mon–Sun with apply weekday chips, then header Apply adds enabled items to today’s stack. Shows Applying when on; tap again to turn off.
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.title: Expand · Apply
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.lead: Expand a group, set color, items, weekdays, and highlighter, then tap Apply to reflect them in today’s stack.
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.c1.label: Expand · post-it color · highlighter
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.c1.detai: Tap the header to expand the body. Inside you can pick post-it color and title highlighter.
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.c2.label: Enable · importance · add items
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.c2.detai: Use switches to pick items, set item importance underlines, or configure with Add new item.
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.c3.label: Apply · weekdays
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.c3.detai: Apply weekday chips plus header Apply put enabled items into today’s stack on those days. When it shows Applying, tap again to turn off.
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.note1: When the focus window ends, Apply is dimmed and shows Focus time has ended. Adjust focus time on Today, then apply again.
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.note2: With Weekend apply on, items auto-appear on Today on the selected days (Sat·Sun by default).
guideBook.page.puzzle.title: Puzzle tab
guideBook.page.puzzle.lead: As you log completions, sticky notes stick on—and your chosen photo slowly comes into view.
guideBook.page.puzzle.c1.label: Puzzle wall
guideBook.page.puzzle.c1.detail: Active and finished puzzles stack as cards. Tap a card to expand and see its pieces.
guideBook.page.puzzle.c2.label: Start a puzzle
guideBook.page.puzzle.c2.detail: Set a target count, photo, and linked routines. Only one puzzle can be in progress at a time.
guideBook.page.puzzle.c3.label: Sticky pieces
guideBook.page.puzzle.c3.detail: Each linked-routine completion adds one sticky note. Hit the target and the photo is complete.
guideBook.page.puzzle.c4.label: Puzzle album
guideBook.page.puzzle.c4.detail: Browse photos from puzzles you’ve finished.
guideBook.page.puzzle.c5.label: Rename · delete
guideBook.page.puzzle.c5.detail: Use the pencil to rename, or trash to select and delete.
guideBook.page.puzzle.note1: Open weekly/monthly stats from Puzzle via “View weekly & monthly records”.
guideBook.page.puzzle.note2: Photos are copied into the app, so deleting them from your library later won’t break the puzzle.
guideBook.page.puzzle-start.title: Starting a puzzle
guideBook.page.puzzle-start.lead: Target count → photo → linked routines → preview, then start.
guideBook.page.puzzle-start.c1.label: Target count
guideBook.page.puzzle-start.c1.detail: Choose how many completions finish the photo. You can’t change this after you start.
guideBook.page.puzzle-start.c2.label: Pick a photo
guideBook.page.puzzle-start.c2.detail: Crop a favorite photo to a square. Sticky notes cover it until records pile up.
guideBook.page.puzzle-start.c3.label: Linked routines
guideBook.page.puzzle-start.c3.detail: Pick which routine completions place a piece. You can combine several routines.
guideBook.page.puzzle-start.c4.label: Preview · start
guideBook.page.puzzle-start.c4.detail: Confirm the name, target, and links, then tap Start puzzle to put it on the wall.
guideBook.page.puzzle-start.note1: You need at least one routine in the Routines tab before you can link any.
guideBook.page.history.title: History
guideBook.page.history.lead: From Puzzle, open “View weekly & monthly records” to review completions and focus.
guideBook.page.history.c1.label: Weekly / Monthly
guideBook.page.history.c1.detail: Switch between weekly and monthly views at the top.
guideBook.page.history.c2.label: Move period
guideBook.page.history.c2.detail: Use the arrows to go to the previous or next week (or month).
guideBook.page.history.c3.label: Weekly summary
guideBook.page.history.c3.detail: See this week’s summary, stats, and top routines.
guideBook.page.history.c4.label: Per-routine card · done dots
guideBook.page.history.c4.detail: Open each routine’s card for more detail. Weekly and monthly done dots fill with that routine’s accent color.
guideBook.page.history.note1: History isn’t a bottom tab—open it from the Puzzle tab.
guideBook.page.history.note2: If you change a routine’s color, history dots update too—so it’s easier to tell routines apart at a glance.
guideBook.page.story.title: Story
guideBook.page.story.lead: Read web articles and save what you like as a routine.
guideBook.page.story.c1.label: Story article
guideBook.page.story.c1.detail: Scroll and read the web body.
guideBook.page.story.c2.label: Title · summary
guideBook.page.story.c2.detail: Review the routine title and summary to save.
guideBook.page.story.c3.label: Save to routine
guideBook.page.story.c3.detail: Saves it straight to the Routines tab.
guideBook.page.settings.title: Settings
guideBook.page.settings.lead: Focus window, layout, typeface, theme, guide, support, and data—all in one place.
guideBook.page.settings.c1.label: Start & wind-down
guideBook.page.settings.c1.detail: Change start and end times on the same 48-hour circular dial as Today.
guideBook.page.settings.c2.label: Layout
guideBook.page.settings.c2.detail: Hide routine icons, the daily quote, Notices button, Contact button, or the Done! tape, and move Complete into the expanded panel.
guideBook.page.settings.c3.label: User guide
guideBook.page.settings.c4.label: Text size · typeface
guideBook.page.settings.c4.detail: Choose Small / Default / Large and a typeface like City Pop Dongle or Hi Melody.
guideBook.page.settings.c5.label: Support · version
guideBook.page.settings.c5.detail: Contact support and check the app version and release notes.
guideBook.page.settings.c6.label: Reset data
guideBook.page.settings.c6.detail: Use this when you want to start the app data from scratch.
guideBook.page.settings.note1: You can also switch light/dark theme in Settings. Hiding Notices or Contact on Today doesn’t remove those actions from Settings.
